studyForm.studyName: Continental-scale metagenomics: leveraging the NSF National Ecological Observatory Network to advance understanding of terrestrial and aquatic microbial communities in response to land use and climate change (AY23_plt04)
studyForm.description: Microbial communities in the soil and water provide the machinery that runs terrestrial and aquatic nutrient cycles and are key to maintaining the flow of energy and materials through the ecosystem. Our project aims to produce freely available metagenomics data of unprecedented scope to enable novel analyses and insights into microbial communities. By linking these genomic data with the wealth of measurements from NEON's long-term ecological monitoring project, this project will provide unmatched opportunities for researchers to explore the fundamental drivers of ecological change from local to continental scales.
